name: Digital Delta Data Centre (DDDC / Digital Delta DC1)
developer: BoFiNet (Botswana Fibre Networks); built by Zhong Gan/CJIC
notes: Vendor-neutral Tier III data centre at BDIH Science & Technology Park, Block 8, Gaborone; 1,000 sqm DC1; Uptime Institute Tier III Constructed Facility certification confirmed by BoFiNet Oct 2025; launch reported 25 Nov 2025 by state/trade press; DCD reports capacity to host at least 400 racks in 1,000 sqm white space. Distinct from the BDIH-branded DC on the same park - do not merge.

name: BDIH Data Centre
notes: Plot 69184, Block 8, BDIH, Gaborone; 80 racks; Tier III compliant; DCaaS colocation; carrier-neutral (BoFiNet, VBN, BTC connected); 2 independent power circuits, UPS + 2 backup generators per official page.

name: BTC Sentlhaga Data Center
notes: Tier II, Uptime-certified; first certified data centre in Botswana; ~120 sqm DC floor, ~52 racks per Botswana Gazette; 5 kW/rack; hosts BTC Cloud Connect (Microsoft 365 resale is service evidence only, not a Microsoft facility).

name: Orange Botswana Data Center
notes: Aggregator-listed facility at New Lobatse Road, Gaborone; datacenters.com lists ISO 14001/22301/27001 certifications and ~2 MW (aggregator figure, unconfirmed by an operator page in this run); official Orange capacity not verified - C-grade lead.

name: Unitel colocation / data-centre service
notes: BOCRA-licensed Gaborone operator marketing fibre backbone + colocation/data-centre service (marketing-level claim per BW methodology); facility-level evidence not re-verified in this run - C-grade lead.

name: AAAS Energy + ChillMine solar-powered data centre campus (Leupane/Palapye)
notes: MoU announced 30 Sep 2025 (DCD) for solar+BESS-powered AI/hyperscale campus at Leupane Energy Hub near Palapye, Central District; hub ties to ~250MW solar PV + ~100MW/400MWh BESS development; datacentermap notes the Leupane hub supports up to 500MW. MoU/announcement only - no DEA/BERA/BPC/council/construction evidence yet; do not count as under construction.

name: Tlou Energy Kala Data Centre (Lesedi, Serowe)
notes: Tlou Energy announced a data centre at its Lesedi CBM project, Serowe, Central District, to be powered by its coalbed-methane gas (Lesedi-4 well); company LinkedIn states the Kala Data Centre is commissioned and operational with initial revenues; capacity/size not publicly detailed - B grade pending company-report confirmation.
